ui:help.en: A JSON POST is sent here whenever a rule blocks a request. Leave empty to disable. With an allowlist egress policy the domain must be approved under the "net" permission.
ui:help.zh: 规则拦截请求时向该地址发送 JSON POST，留空则不发送。出口策略为白名单时，域名需在 net 权限中获批。

ui:help.en: Send at most one alert per rule within this many seconds, across all nodes (0–300). Requests are still blocked and logged during the cooldown, just not alerted. 0 sends an alert for every blocked request. Cluster-wide throttling needs the optional "lock" permission; without it each node throttles on its own, up to one alert per node.
ui:help.zh: 同一条规则在这段时间内全集群最多发送一次告警（0–300 秒）。冷却期内请求照常拦截和记录，只是不再告警。0 表示每次拦截都发送。全集群节流需要可选的 lock 权限；未授权时各节点各自节流，每个节点最多各发一次。

ui:help.en: Store about 120 characters around the match in the block log and alerts. May contain user data.
ui:help.zh: 在拦截记录和告警中保存命中位置附近约 120 个字符，可能包含用户数据。
